note.en: The inspected biographies establish a short encounter interval, not three separately dated life events.
note.zh: 所查资料能确定一段会见时期，不能据此编造三个独立的生平日期。

note.en: Two conventionally dated battles are supportable; no third dated event or exact lifespan is established.
note.zh: 能支持两个通行战役纪年，不能据此增添第三个日期或精确生卒年。

note.en: Only a traditional endpoint is available; poems and retrospective anecdotes cannot supply three dated milestones.
note.zh: 仅能提供传统的生平终点，诗篇与后世轶事不能构成三个确定纪年。

note.en: Only two independently anchored events are needed for this focused profile; no third date is invented from undated anecdotes.
note.zh: 此篇聚焦传记仅有两个可定位事件，不以未纪年的轶事编造第三个日期。

note.en: The inspected sources establish resignation and death; the undated literary and biographical episodes do not justify a third dated milestone.
note.zh: 所查资料确定辞官与去世，未纪年的文学及传记情节不足以支持第三个日期。

note.en: Two distinct episodes are supported in the revolt year. The inherited birth year and the 207 BCE death date are not retained; precise conversion of the later death month is outside this profile.
note.zh: 起事年份可支持两个独立事迹。未保留原目录的出生年与前207年卒年；后续去世月份的精确换算不在本条范围内。

note.en: The signed-in service accepted a world-history research brief and a focused chronology request. Both remained at generating a research plan during preparation. No Gemini report or unsupported AI findings were adopted.
note.zh: 已登录服务接受了世界史研究纲要及针对编年的请求；准备期间均停留在生成研究计划阶段。未采用尚未返回的Gemini报告或无来源支持的AI结论。

researchService.evidencePolicy: Historical evidence comes from the individually cited sources and their disclosed retrieval limits.

followup.method: Original bilingual biographies and regional stories from inspected historical texts, scholarship and institutional records. Source-profile identities are retained; explicit chronology reviews explain sparse dated evidence. Jiangshan updates are credited as method and topic leads; image rights remain separate.

method.en: V18 connects historical images with their stories, adds object-centered readings and side-by-side looking exercises, and preserves released narratives with separate source-backed corrections.
method.zh: V18把历史图像与故事连接起来，新增以文物为中心的阅读与图像对照，并以独立、有据可查的校订层保留已发布叙事。
